text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Suzuka-san? Aren't you going for a 
run today?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Somehow, today... I just don't feel 
like I can run at my best... a bit.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Suzuka-san...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Then why not come hang out with us? 
Wear a cute swimsuit and get in the mood!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Thank you, Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day during the camp. Silence Suzuka 
seemed to be heading out, but she looked 
somewhat melancholic. Worried, I decided 
to follow her for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
The ball went over there! Toss it back, 
plea~se!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah, um...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Oops, both of us hesitated and let the 
ball drop.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry... ...I'll go fetch the ball.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, what a nice breeze...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...If I run right now, would it clear my 
head a bit... I wonder?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Suzuka-chaaan! Did you find the ball!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ! I'm on my way...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry I'm late. It took a bit of time 
to find the ball...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-san... Um, are you okay? Would you 
like to... take a little break?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
............ ...You're right. I'm sorry, 
Spe-chan. I'll rest for just a little 
bit...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Lately, it feels like things just 
haven't been going right for me like 
this...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm just not sure how to fit in with 
everyone..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...It's difficult. I just can't help 
worrying about everyone...
Zzz... Zzz... Mmn.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: *Yawn*... Ah, I slept so well~.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
B-Bright? Since when were you... Weren't 
you just hanging out with everyone from 
the Mejiro family a moment ago?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Howaa~... That is true, but I was taking 
some time for a nap. Because I got 
sleepy~.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Just because you got sleepy...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Um, this might sound like a strange 
question. Do you, well... ever feel like 
it's hard to keep up with everyone else's 
pace?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Pace.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm? I've never really paid much 
attention to that~

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But, having to coordinate our 
schedules together, isn't that...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu~. Everyone is so soft, cozy, and 
kind...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Worrying about that is... ...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting... Wait, huh? Where's 
Bright?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
She is taking a nap over there. Hehe, let 
us leave her be.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, typical as always. Well then, let's 
go buy some juice too.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Dober and the others don't mind, do 
they... Even if Bright wanders off 
somewhere else on her own.
choice_data_list: Looks like everyone's accepting of it.
Looks like everyone's accepting of it.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...They'll accept me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "Could it be... I was overthinking it...?"
choice_data_list:
Worrying too much isn't good for you 
either.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, what is it... hehe.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...Bright, do you mind if I join you? A 
nice breeze blows through here, after 
all..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Suzuka-saaan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
How are you feeling? I was a bit 
worried...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, hehe! Oh, you were just taking a 
nap!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, I'll join you on the side! 
Ehehe... ♪

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. Trying to be considerate ended 
up backfiring completely...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Suzuka-saaan! Are you okaaaay!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You didn't look like you were feeling very 
well, so... I bought a drink for you! It's 
delicious, so I thought it might cheer you 
up...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Spe-chan... thank you. I'm alright now.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, do you want to talk for a bit? If 
it's okay with you, Spe-chan..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ! Of course! Let's take it easy and relax♪
